hooks.text: Half of the Moon is permanently frozen in total darkness, right?
There is no permanent dark side of the Moon.
The far side of the Moon gets equal sunlight.

title: The Myth of the Moon's Dark Side
description: Despite popular belief, the far side of the Moon receives as much sunlight as the near side. Here is how lunar phases actually light up the unseen hemisphere.

beats.text: Operating spacecraft on the far side requires relay satellites because the Moon blocks radio signals.
